title: Lower ME: Front Squat + Speed
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Front Squat 3 · 6-sec lower @ RPE 7 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Eccentric wk 1: 6 sec down, then drive up hard · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · elbows high
note: Strength block starts. Slow 6-second lowering on the main lift, then explode. Expect soreness: accessories are cut back.
